offers.description: Please hold on. Assignment coming up. This might be a bit tough for you, but what the heck... here goes. Some sick individual (Douglass Guynes) has acquired a large supply of Permanent Killing equipment, and is using it. These PK weapons are quite new and not functioning 100% yet. (Not all people are susceptible to them, seems.) If the person with this equipment manages to encode the neural signal of the target onto the Neural Disruption Weapon, and then strikes a killing blow with it, the 'essence' or 'soul' of the victim is lost to the world! The result is terrible: no resurrection in our great resurrection machines, resulting in permanent DEATH! (As in the 'good' old way.) Please stop this lunatic before he can send more people away with no return ticket! Hurry, he is in Omni-1 Trade for 48 hours! Take care now.

offers.description: Well. Not much to choose from right now. Still, this might be something for you: We are tracking down an important criminal.  You need to follow a lead for us, please.  In Omni-1 Trade, inside the a house, you will find the Personalized Encrypted Information.  Please bring it to us within 48 hours, and we shall reward you greatly.

The last message we received was that the survivors had taken refuge in the Fire and Radiation Chamber. Use the Fire_Slapon_XX03 to give them relief - they will only be able to hold out for 48 hours! You will find them at 325.1, 466.4 in the area of Trade District. Good luck, Shade. Oh yes, you would like some advance compensation? How does 1224 credits and 2026 experience points sound?
